tools.name: get_dataset_info
tools.description: Describes the free ShelfXray / Dark Store Index quick-commerce shelf dataset: platforms, cities, categories, searched keywords, read dates, method, limitations and how to cite it. Call first. Cached data, not live.

tools.name: brand_shelf_snapshot
tools.description: For one brand, shows how it appeared on the Blinkit / Zepto / Swiggy Instamart shelf in Bengaluru and Delhi NCR: stores present, coverage %, best and lowest rank seen, and sponsored slots owned, per search keyword. Cached data with read dates. Only top-8 brands per search are recorded.

tools.name: category_benchmark
tools.description: Benchmarks a category (Coffee, Protein & energy bars, Baby care) by platform and city: average distinct brands per search, results depth, share of store reads showing a sponsored result, sponsored slots held by the top brands, and shelf price range. Cached data.

tools.name: search_rank_summary
tools.description: For a searched keyword (e.g. "protein bar"), shows per platform and city which brands led the shelf (store coverage, best rank, sponsored slots), how many stores showed an ad, results depth and price spread. Cached data.

tools.name: sponsored_slot_leaders
tools.description: Ranks brands by sponsored placements owned (slots, not spend) on the quick-commerce shelf, optionally filtered by platform, city, category or keyword. Answers "who is buying the slots above me?". Cached data.
